name: Speakeasy Tonight
source:
The year is 1926...

You are sent off to your uncle in Chicago by your parents for "bad" behavior where you seek a future decided by none other than yourself.

As you dive into a new world, you suddenly find out about the existence of the speakeasy by accident, and learn that your uncle is deeply tied in the underground world of speakeasies.

After a chance encounter with two striking men, you find yourself falling deep into the glamorous but dangerous world of the speakeasy, with illegal booze, hot jazz, and even hotter men!

It's the height of the jazz age...and you're right in the middle of it...

Welcome to the Roaring Twenties!

[Taken from [url=http://koi-game.voltage.co.jp/en/graphic/speak/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
1926年……

父母因你“行为不端”，把你送到芝加哥投靠叔叔。在那里，你要寻找一条完全由自己决定的未来。

踏入新世界后，你偶然发现了地下酒吧的存在，并得知叔叔与这个地下酒吧圈子关系密切。

一次偶遇后，你结识了两名魅力非凡的男人，逐渐陷入奢华却危险的地下酒吧世界：非法酒水、热烈爵士，以及更加火热的男人！

这是爵士时代最鼎盛的时期……而你正身处其中。

欢迎来到咆哮的二十年代！

[取自[url=http://koi-game.voltage.co.jp/en/graphic/speak/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
